Huong leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Hushpuppy. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)

🔥 The fire settles. Huong has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. DeShawn mutters "Say that again — slower." Ruth says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
